run_paged_attention_v1: run paged attention v1 kernel for transformer inference with key-value cache and block tables
run_scaled_fp8_quant: run FP8 quantization on a 2D tensor with static or dynamic per-token scaling
run_cutlass_scaled_mm: run CUTLASS scaled matrix multiplication with group-wise broadcasting for FP8 quantized GEMM
run_fused_moe: run CPU fused mixture-of-experts GEMM with top-k routing and activation functions
run_moe_align_block_size: run MoE block size alignment to sort tokens and assign them to experts for grouped GEMM
